text.name: Big Bang Enlargement 2004
text.rules: Record "eastward". LIO spends 3 points. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: Seven countries, including the three Baltic states, joined NATO on 29 March 2004, and ten countries joined the European Union on 1 May 2004.
